description: Checks one product version: supported, security-only or end-of-life on the given date, with the end dates, days remaining or overdue, the latest patch in that cycle, the newest cycle and the recommended upgrade. Accepts versions as people write them: "8", "8.0.11", "net8.0", "net472", "4.8", "v18.19.0", "lts/hydrogen", "3.12".

date.description: Date to evaluate support on, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today. Use it for "will this still be supported on ...?" questions.

product.description: Product id or common name, for example "dotnet", "dotnetfx", "nodejs", "python", "angularjs".

version.description: Version or release cycle, for example "8", "6.0.25", "net6.0", "net48", "1.8.2", "3.9".

name: check_version
title: Check a version
